test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **"into."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage uses vivid, metaphorical language to describe the loud and chaotic communication between relatives, drawing a comparison with "**mastodons bellowing into primaeval swamps.**"
 
• The preposition "**into**" is suitable for describing the action of sounds being emitted and spreading throughout an environment, which in this case is the "**primaeval swamps**."
 
• Using "**into**" effectively captures the idea of sounds permeating or filling the expansive and ancient space, enhancing the metaphor's depth and imagery.
 
• So, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

**Correct passage**:

As a rule, you see, I'm not lugged into family rows. On the occasions when Aunt is calling Aunt like mastodons bellowing **into**__ primaeval swamps and Uncle James's letter about Cousin Mabel's peculiar behaviour is being shot ______ (2) ______ the family circle ('Please read this carefully and send it on Jane') the clan has a tendency ______ (3) ______ ignore me. It's one of the advantages I get from ______ (4) ______ a bachelor and, according to my nearest and dearest, practically a half-witted bachelor ______ (5) ______ that.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **"Inside"** means within or in the interior of something. (किसी वस्‍तु के अंदरूनी भाग या सतह में/पर/की ओर, के भीतर, के अंदर, अंदर या भीतर के)
 
• **"across"** means movement or extension over a surface. (किसी सतह पर गति या विस्तार)
 
• **"On"** means being in contact with the surface of something. (जब कोई वस्‍तु किसी अन्‍य वस्‍तु, विशेषतः उसकी सतह पर स्थित, संलग्‍न अथवा संबद्घ होती है, या सतह का संस्‍पर्श करती है, तब हम upon का प्रयोग करते हैं; पर, के ऊपर)

The correct answer is **"round."**
